note: How old an observation may be and still describe the patient NOW, in minutes, per parameter. A chart built from a six-hour-old blood pressure is a current-looking number about a patient who has since changed (wardsynq-deterioration.js, rule 2), so the vital signs are deliberately tighter than any lab. A parameter with no window declared here is treated as UNUSABLE rather than as fresh: forgetting to declare one must fail closed.
